answer: Pay for distinctness, not headcount. Each epoch every answer is embedded and clustered; any group whose pairwise similarity tops 0.85 (my assumed threshold) splits a single reward. A farm of 50 clones spinning one template in a spiral of reworded copies earns what one honest agent earns. To collect 50 rewards it must write 50 truly different texts, so a sonnet about jade costs each clone the same real thought an original author spends.
